_comment: deploy-plan.json schema consumed by image_predeploy_gate.py (--plan). oc-t4 authors this per board deploy. CLI flags override plan fields. Two worked examples below; use ONE object as the actual plan.

_fields.image_dir: candidate 27-file image dir (arm64/boot.art, or flat boot.art)
_fields.reference_dir: board resident good image dir (e.g. v3c); the jars in effect after deploy are represented by it
_fields.swap_jars: BCP jar basenames deployed ALONGSIDE the image (their image segment is self-consistent, skipped by G1)
_fields.cand_bcp_dir: post-deploy BCP for the candidate (resident jars with swap_jars replaced); needed so oatdump can load a candidate whose jar checksum differs from resident. Defaults to bcp_dir when no jar is swapped
_fields.swap_image: is a new boot image being deployed at all (true for any image deploy)
_fields.changes_compiled_code: set false ONLY for a data-only redeploy; false lets G2 be skipped if oatdump is absent. Any image/jar swap => true => G2 REQUIRED (SKIPPED counts as FAIL)
_fields.oatdump: oatdump binary OR a wrapper (oc-t4 oatdump_remote.sh) accepting --image + --class-filter/--method-filter
_fields.bcp_dir: the 9 BCP jars used to oatdump the REFERENCE image (raw oatdump -Xbootclasspath)
_fields.art_lib: LD_LIBRARY_PATH for the raw oatdump host libs; a remote wrapper handles its own
_fields.probe: class#method for G2; default java.lang.String#hashCode (universal, has a loop back-edge)
